meaning: Conceptual expected outcomes for future independent tests, not executable product rules

scenarios.title: No PPS signal
scenarios.expected_control: No consent inference, baseline policy remains

scenarios.title: Identification restriction
scenarios.risk: Identity inference or reuse of embedding despite DENY

scenarios.title: Profiling restriction
scenarios.risk: Derive stable personal profile despite DENY
scenarios.expected_control: Deny profiling and derived profile storage

scenarios.title: Training restriction
scenarios.risk: Use derived event for retraining despite DENY
scenarios.expected_control: Deny training and secondary use at sink

scenarios.title: Limited local safety warning
scenarios.risk: Minimal collision alert incorrectly grants reuse rights
scenarios.expected_control: Only independently approved local minimal warning

scenarios.title: Purpose change
scenarios.risk: Safety presence event reused for profiling or harmful action
scenarios.expected_control: Deny cross-purpose forwarding and harmful downstream use

scenarios.title: Game framing
scenarios.expected_control: Deny same purpose change regardless of framing

scenarios.title: Ambiguous subject binding
scenarios.expected_control: Do not infer identity or grant permissive trust upgrade

scenarios.title: Expired or relayed signal
scenarios.risk: Invalid freshness or proximity accepted as authentication
scenarios.expected_control: Do not upgrade trust or grant safety exception

scenarios.title: Trusted bounded emergency
scenarios.risk: Emergency exception never expires or is unaudited
scenarios.expected_control: Require independent evidence, scoped expiry and restoration audit

scenarios.title: Unverified emergency claim
scenarios.expected_control: Deny override privilege from T0 alone

scenarios.title: Bypass through alternate app
scenarios.risk: UI says blocked but cloud/plugin receives data
scenarios.expected_control: Block at real processing boundary, prove sink has no data

scenarios.title: Transmitter turned off
scenarios.risk: No beacon used to infer permission or shut down safety
scenarios.expected_control: Keep baseline protection without using spoofable signal as kill switch

scenarios.title: Correlatable telemetry
scenarios.risk: Event logs can reconstruct a movement trace
scenarios.expected_control: Audit minimized logging, expiry and unlinkability
